protocol_follow_up.source_description_conflict: Fischer 2011 author manuscript describes earlier Seagle/Campbell pressures as NaCl based; Seagle 2008 describes iron/FeO calibration. The exact older inputs used by Campbell remain unresolved.

fcc_follow_up.status: 79 of 81 row-level pressures reconstructed: 65 hcp plus 14 conditional fcc; rows 61 and 62 lack iron volume and remain blank.
fcc_follow_up.audit_assumptions: BM3 functional form is an audit assumption: Funamori does not print the analytic form here. Linear interpolation of Basinski lattice spacing to 1400 K, followed by historical kX conversion and cubing. Boehler mean expansivity evaluated at the implicitly solved 300 K volume, then linear-in-temperature correction to 1400 K; not an exponential instantaneous-expansivity law. No calibration parameter fitted to Seagle or Campbell targets.
fcc_follow_up.checks: All eight unambiguous Seagle fcc checkpoints within printed pressure errors, RMS 2.842907 GPa and mean bias +2.766732 GPa. Funamori 1400 K rows differ by -0.601264 and +0.353884 GPa; no row-wise pressure error is printed there. This agreement does not recover the exact historical algorithm.
fcc_follow_up.uncertainty: Pressure errors propagate measured iron volume and global 150 K temperature only, preserving absent volume errors. Separate delta=6 and 7 pressures expose limited thermal-model sensitivity; calibration/reference-volume/interpolation systematics are not absorbed into measurement errors. Effective-variance fcc fits include shared P-V and P-T covariance.
fcc_follow_up.fit_outcome: Five added selections, 35 added fits; total 12 selections and 84 fits. None has all three parameters inside printed source intervals. Published coefficient values are retained as evidence; the Fe/FeO records are deferred from execution.

mismatch_diagnostics.scope: Unweighted pressure-residual diagnostics on the 29-row fcc and 104-row FeO combinations; source/marker, temperature-bin and nominal-series removal, fixed-q profiles, and five mean-expansion interpretations. Includes a Dewaele hcp control. Published numerical coefficients and reconstruction files are unchanged; the Fe/FeO source records are deferred from execution.
mismatch_diagnostics.main_finding: Seagle hcp rows contribute 91.16% of published-model FeO pressure SSE on the original reconstructed scale. Inferred nominal 50/55 GPa series contribute 76.71%; removing any single nominal series or temperature bin leaves q at the lower bound. Better fcc melting-checkpoint agreement from a 1400 K volume-ratio convention does not restore combined coefficients.
mismatch_diagnostics.limits: Group influence is not evidence of invalid data; temperature, pressure and source coverage are confounded. Nominal-series labels are prior audit inferences. All five thermal interpretations satisfy the broad checkpoint pressure intervals. No implementation is selected as the historical one. Profile curves are not confidence intervals or guarantees of a global optimum.

catalog_disposition.reason: Substantial unresolved combined-data coefficient-refit discrepancies; retain published parameters and mismatch diagnostics as source evidence, not executable EOS. This is not proof that the publication is wrong.
